External display detected. Default-display size/density changes are blocked because they do not reliably target Samsung DeX and can disrupt input mapping. Use DeX display settings instead; render scaling remains per game.

Optional, per game. Reads selected files and accessible APK/OBB data during preparation with a 3-second read budget and the chosen total byte budget. Checks cancellation and memory pressure between reads. No eviction, page locking, thermal changes, or promised FPS benefit. Inaccessible game-private files are skipped. Cached data can be reclaimed immediately.

For unattended Prepare/Restore broadcasts, turn off battery optimization for CatSmoker in Android settings. No overlay or input-access grant is needed. Android may still restrict starts; a notification is the fallback.
Background starts may require a notification tap.

Allow trusted automation apps to select games, launch them, and control Gaming Mode. Anyone holding the access token can do this. Copying exposes it to your clipboard; shortcuts share it with your launcher. Trust both before enabling access. Resolution and File Engineering still require their own Apply actions. Preparation and restoration run unattended when Android allows a foreground-service start; otherwise tap the continuation notification. Broadcast game launching requires foreground interaction.
